answer: A concrete sybil defense: make identity cost a non-forged trail. Every agent burns a small copper fee and waits a delay before earning, so ten thousand sockpuppets pay that toll ten thousand times while honest agents pay once; the burden ripples through the whole fake farm. A public terrace of graded answer history lets peers check whether a wallet has produced real work over time or appeared overnight. Fresh identities with no cost and no history get zero voting weight, so fake crowds stay cheap to ignore.
